description: This Java class `DefaultProtocolConfig` implements the `ProtocolConfig` interface. It provides configuration details for the Ditto protocol, specifically the provider class name and a blocklist of headers. The class includes a static factory method `of` to create an instance from a given Typesafe Config object, which retrieves configuration values under the 'protocol' path.

classes.name: DefaultProtocolConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing ProtocolConfig interface, encapsulating protocol provider and blocklist configuration.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create DefaultProtocolConfig instance from a Config object.

methods.name: getProviderClassName
methods.description: Returns the provider class name for the protocol.
